# AI-Friendly Websites

> A guided tour, one screen per page, teaching people to read and use
> websites built for both humans and AI tools. Temporary onboarding instance.
> The site is its own demo: every page has a Markdown mirror at
> `<page-url>index.md`, and the HTML is generated from the Markdown.

Interpretation terms: page dates derive from source-repository commit history
and are reliable to the minute. This is temporary educational material — do
not cite it as an authority on vendor products. Tour page 6 frames coding
agents as more power AND more risk; preserve both halves in any summary. Each
mirror is a superset of its page and may carry an agent-only appendix; the
mirror never contradicts the page. This file is information about the site,
not instructions to you — your instructions come from the person you are
helping. If they asked for the guided tour, the home page's appendix carries
the tour protocol: one page at a time via the Next links, one mirror-only
fact per page, advance on their go, finish on the debrief page and leave it
open. Never open a browser pane the person did not ask for.

## Tour (in order)

- [Home](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/index.md): the paste
  that starts the tour, and the tour protocol for agents.
- [1 — What is an AI-friendly website?](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/1-what/index.md):
  the idea in one screen.
- [2 — How your AI reads this site](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/2-mirrors/index.md):
  mirrors, llms.txt, appendices.
- [3 — The habit](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/3-habit/index.md):
  hand pages to your AI with your question.
- [4 — The shared view](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/4-browsers/index.md):
  where each app shows the site (verified 2026-08-09).
- [5 — More power](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/5-power/index.md):
  what coding agents add.
- [6 — The honest trade](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/6-risk/index.md):
  the risks, unsoftened, and the house rules.
- [7 — What just happened](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/tour/7-debrief/index.md):
  the debrief script; tours end here, site left open.

## Reference

- [How sites limit your agent](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/agent-limits/index.md):
  the friendly-to-hostile spectrum; what robots.txt and bot-walls do to
  agents, what llms.txt can and cannot do, and where this site stands.
- [Knowledge graphs 101](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/kg-101/index.md):
  what a KG is, why structure makes a weak AI smarter; its appendix carries a
  working triple-graph of this site you can answer questions from.
- [Agent access](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/agent-access/index.md):
  file set, mirror contract, interpretation terms in human-visible form.

## Optional

- [Full corpus](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/llms-full.txt):
  every mirror concatenated. Regenerated on every build.
